entries.zh: 招认；认罪，凭证据（迹象）供认
entries.en: to confess, to own up; to confess on the evidence of the indications

entries.zh: 错认；误认（把不是的认作是）
entries.en: to misrecognize; to mistake one thing for another
entries.notes: 汉字錯認与闽南语、官话两栏对音一致，西语词头 confessar lo que no queria（供认所不愿者）与之不合，疑手稿行位串置，故依汉字释义。

entries.zh: 供罪；供认罪过，认罪（逐项招供）
entries.en: to confess a crime/sin; to confess item by item (over each one)
entries.notes: 西语词头 confessar super cada . 疑为截断（sobre cada uno），依忏罪语境与汉字供罪释义。

entries.en: to confess and acknowledge one's crime/sin
entries.notes: 西语词头同第3条疑截断，据汉字供認罪释义。

entries.zh: 口词多；话多，供词繁多（能言善辩）
entries.en: to have much to say; to be talkative; to make a lengthy (confession) statement
to admit, to own up; to acknowledge as one's own
entries.notes: 汉字食認与西语多义项词头（已供认；因疑改投他人等）对应关系不甚吻合，据汉字与对音释义。

entries.en: to substitute for, to act in place of; to entrust to another
entries.notes: 汉字替（替代）与词头 confiar en otro（信托他人）义有张力，取托人代为之关联；官话栏音调污损（T99）。

entries.en: to lean on, to rely on, to depend on
entries.notes: 闽南语栏残损（[残]/T99），据汉字靠与西语词头释义；词头内嵌 tty cau : 疑为音写串入。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字律存疑（[疑:彼]），闽南语栏残损（[残]/T99），四栏无法互证，释义无法定夺。

entries.en: to lean on, to rely on
entries.notes: 音写两栏污损（[残]/T99），据汉字倚与西语词头释义，语义明确但四栏互证不全。

entries.en: to rely on, to count on, to trust in (another)
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字換与词头义不合，闽南语栏残损（[残]/T99），官话对音 othuan 异常，释义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 怙伊扶持；倚仗他人扶持
entries.en: to rely on him (another) for support; to lean on another's backing
entries.notes: 官话栏一字音调污损（T99），闽南语栏仅录三音节；据汉字词组释义，语义明确。

entries.zh: 顾、怙；倚仗他人，托付照看
entries.en: to rely on another; to place (one's hope/trust) in another for a matter
entries.notes: 西语词头残缺（tener puestas [残]），汉字首字存疑（[疑:皆]），据可辨之顧、怙两字释义。

entries.zh: 管、顾、怙；照管看顾，倚仗他人
entries.en: to look after and rely on; to care for, to trust in another
to rely on power or influence; to presume upon one's position
to form ties of friendship; to contract an alliance with another
to lean on, to rely on, to depend on
to rely on, to depend upon
entries.notes: 闽南语栏含行间插入语 tog nay（托赖，与本页第21条重复）。

entries.en: to rely on power or influence; to lean on one's position
to rely on, to lean upon; to fall back on
